resonant cyclotron Compton scattering by charge carriers threading the magnetospheres of magnetars will strongly influence the observed X-ray spectra and light curves of SGR and A XP sources.

the SGR and AXPs are not ordinary pulsars, but rather are a distinct subclass of neutron stars with strong, tangled surface magnetic fields, which are maintained by the dissipation of magnetic stresses deep inside the star.
